blurb: Over the past 50 years, The Whole Backstage Community Theatre has produced a wide range of quality shows and this season is no exception. The WBS is an all-volunteer, non-profit organization. It is the oldest continually operating community theatre in North Alabama and exists solely through the generous support of its patrons.
